column1: # Partition table for the PCAN-USB ESP32-S3 emulator (8 MB flash
# CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHSIZE_8MB). A single large app partition + NVS (mode
# persistence) + phy_init. The table ends at 0x10000 + 0x300000 = 0x310000
# larger flash — but CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_FLASHSIZE must match the module.
# No OTA: this is a bench tool flashed over USB/JTAG
